description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures, including a check function and an upgrade function that defaults to a generic upgrade method unless a specific board name is matched.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a check on the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes the firmware upgrade process, delegating to default_do_upgrade for unspecified boards.
